title: Zesty Smoky American Goose Stir Fry
description: A smoky and savory weeknight dish featuring goose fat and a variety of vegetables, perfect for a low-carb dinner
instructions: Heat the goose fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat until melted and smoky
Add the goose breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through
Remove the goose breast from the skillet and set aside to rest
Add the smoked paprika and garlic powder to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender
Add the snow peas to the skillet and cook until tender but still crisp
Return the goose breast to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices
Season the stir fry with salt and black pepper to taste
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
